articles.title: How to check a marketplace payout file
articles.summary: Open a marketplace payout (settlement) file, map its columns, match orders with your invoices and see returns, fees, TCS, TDS and any shortfall.

articles.title: Add a marketplace payout to your books

articles.summary: Record a marketplace payout in NSBiz: money received, fees as an expense, TCS and TDS receivable, clearing what the marketplace owes you.
